ligand.name: DINP
ligand.mixture_caveat: Commercial DINP is a branched-isomer mixture; this input is one documented representative structure.

recommended_md.ligand_force_field: GAFF2/AMBER or OpenFF; record exact version and charge method

minimum_qc: Confirm the complex topology contains one PPARG protein and one DINP ligand with matching atom order.
Validate ligand net charge, atom types, bonded terms and partial charges before production.
Minimize and equilibrate before production; monitor temperature, pressure, density and potential energy.
Report protein C-alpha RMSD/RMSF, ligand RMSD after protein alignment, ligand-pocket contacts, hydrogen bonds, radius of gyration and SASA.
Use the alternate PPARG pose as a sensitivity run if the seed-20260909 pose does not remain in the pocket during equilibration.
interpretation_boundary: MD stability supports structural plausibility only; it does not establish experimental affinity, DINP isomer-mixture behavior or causal PPARG-to-CEBPB regulation.
